==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{OutlawsHeader}}</nowiki></code>

To allow for placing the "main" story events in the order of [[Kijimi]], [[Tatooine]], then [[Akiva]] on mainspace articles. While this order is not strictly [[canon]]ical, narrative directors [[Navid Khavari]] and [[John Björling]] recommended [[Wookieepedia]] order events in this way due to a need to place the events in some form of order to summarize them, indicating that it matched the production order.
